gloss: slightly thin; on the light side; a bit diluted

definitions.gloss: somewhat thin, light, or diluted; on the weak side
definitions.explanation: Formed from {薄|うす}い (thin, light, weak, diluted) + め (suffix indicating 'somewhat' or 'on the _ side'). Describes something that is moderately thin, light in color, diluted, or sparse — slightly below average intensity.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄|うす}めにして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make the coffee on the weak side.
I chose a lighter shade of blue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄|うす}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧、⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かした⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧にした。
examples.english: Today I seasoned lightly with salt and made a dish that brings out the natural flavors.

notes:
Formed by attaching め to the adjective stem {薄|うす}. This め suffix softens the adjective: '(a little) on the thin/light side.' It is used for color, liquid concentration, fabric thickness, and seasoning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄|うす}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: with light seasoning
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄|うす}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in a light shade
- {薄|うす}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut thinly
- {薄|うす}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply thinly

NOTE: The め suffix can attach to many adjective stems: {厚|あつ}め (somewhat thick), {濃|こ}いめ/こいめ (somewhat strong/dark), ⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧ (somewhat much), etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: thin, light, diluted — the base adjective; stronger than うすめ
- ⟦{淡|あわ}い→淡い：13293_awai⟧: faint, pale — emphasizes delicateness of color or sensation
